# thalassa_iam_policy_rule (Resource)

Manage a permission rule for a project IAM policy in Thalassa Cloud. Requires projects to be enabled for the organisation (currently private beta).

See [IAM documentation](https://docs.thalassa.cloud/docs/iam/).


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (List of String) List of permissions (create, read, update, delete, list, *)
- `policy_id` (String) Identity of the IAM policy this rule belongs to
- `resources` (List of String) List of resources this rule applies to

### Optional

- `note` (String) Human-readable note for the permission rule
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the IAM policy rule. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `resource_identities` (List of String) List of specific resource identities this rule applies to

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identity of the permission rule
